baseline_rule: For each leg, empirical probability of a historical change strictly greater than threshold minus current value, using disjoint 7/12-observation intervals ending 23 Nov, Beta(2,2).

ust-promo-v1-20261202-2y.question: Will the 2-year Treasury par yield, in percent be strictly greater than 4.65 on the first official observation dated on or after 2026-12-02?

ust-promo-v1-20261202-spread.question: Will the 10-year minus 2-year Treasury par yield spread, in percentage points be strictly greater than 0.30 on the first official observation dated on or after 2026-12-02?

ust-promo-v1-20261209-2y.question: Will the 2-year Treasury par yield, in percent be strictly greater than 4.65 on the first official observation dated on or after 2026-12-09?

ust-promo-v1-20261209-spread.question: Will the 10-year minus 2-year Treasury par yield spread, in percentage points be strictly greater than 0.30 on the first official observation dated on or after 2026-12-09?

resolution_rule: First official observation dated between the stated start and its sixth following calendar day inclusive. Strict >, ties NO. Wait two calendar days after that observation and lock the first recorded resolution. Both horizons are correlated. No tournament questions, no trading.
